questions.q: What does a payment method describe?
options: The approval hierarchy for an invoice
The mechanism used to pay a supplier, such as check, EFT, or wire
The tax rate applied to a payment
The chart of accounts segment used for a payment
questions.explain: Payment method is the basic mechanism of payment -- check, electronic funds transfer, or wire.

questions.q: What does a Payment Process Profile (PPP) add beyond the payment method itself?
options: Nothing -- it is identical to the payment method
Only the supplier's tax identification number
The disbursement bank account, file format, grouping rules, and processing limits
The invoice's matching type (two-way, three-way, four-way)
questions.explain: A PPP is the operational rulebook behind a payment method: which account funds it, what file/document format is produced, how invoices group, and the limits applied.

questions.q: Why might the same payment method (e.g., EFT) require more than one Payment Process Profile?
options: Because different populations of suppliers may need different bank accounts or file formats, like NACHA vs. ISO 20022
It never does -- one method always has exactly one profile
Because Oracle requires a new profile every fiscal year
Because each invoice needs its own unique profile
questions.explain: Domestic and international EFT payments, for example, may need different disbursement accounts and different electronic file formats, even though both use EFT as the method.

questions.q: In the example, Cascade Industrial Parts is paid through the "US Domestic ACH" profile. What file format does that profile generate?
options: A printed check layout
SWIFT MT103
NACHA
questions.explain: The US Domestic ACH profile in the example generates a NACHA-formatted electronic payment file.

questions.q: What restricts which payment methods can be used for a given supplier?
options: The invoice's matching type
The allowed payment methods configured on the supplier site, tied to bank account details on file
The fiscal calendar period
The general ledger chart of accounts
questions.explain: Each supplier site can be restricted to specific allowed payment methods, which depend on verified bank account information being on file.
